observation: Acceptance withdrawn under the strengthened original-artwork fidelity requirement. All 120 source frames and all 120 tracked original-pixel print crops were rechecked against the original image. During the later hand contact and charm tilt the printed eyes become markedly narrower; the earlier conclusion relied on some violet iris remaining visible, which is not enough to certify that eyelid and iris shapes preserve the original print. The whole charm also tilts, so this does not assert that every apparent narrowing is an autonomous blink; the late interval is declined because faithful fixed eye geometry cannot be confidently verified. One existing woman remains in the original cropped feminine costume with no face, added person or hard cut. Preserve raw and previous decision; a clearly open-eye early interval requires independent new review before any selection.
